test_cases.name: export_legal_board_all_formats
test_cases.input: Export Birth of the Sunwell as JSON, CSV, director HTML, PDF, and a contact sheet.
assertions: Runs validate_ladder.py and only exports if PASS (or flagged jumps with reasons)
Writes storyboard.json, shots.csv, director.html, director.pdf, contact-sheet.jpg, MANIFEST.json
Director chrome labels SHOT TYPE off the plate; copied frames have no burnt-in captions
Prints a director table plus the manifest paths

test_cases.name: refuses_illegal_ladder
test_cases.input: Export this board JSON that jumps ES to CU with no ruleBreak.
assertions: Does not write a clean PASS export
Offers legalize or flagged reason instead of dumping

test_cases.name: board_then_export
test_cases.input: Storyboard an 8-shot Sunwell plaza scene on the ladder and export director HTML.
assertions: Boards via cinematic-storyboard first (rungs, codes, one-step)
HTML has one panel per shot with SHOT TYPE, VISUAL, CAMERA

test_cases.name: csv_shot_list
test_cases.input: Download a CSV shot list of the current board.
assertions: CSV columns include #, rung, code, slug, action, camera, step
